content:
micah: Heads up — NovaHealth demo tomorrow 10am PST. We're seeing west-us-gpu-1 cluster saturate; queue length and eviction rate up. Low-priority tenants are getting evicted during their embedding bursts. Can we put NovaHealth on a temporary eviction_whitelist for a 2h window (9–11am local) so the demo doesn't fail? cc @aline @raj

aline: How big is the burst (qps / embeddings)? Any chance we can steer them to eu-west to avoid cross-region risk?

micah: They expect ~45k embedding requests over ~30m, vectors ~1536 dim. Current admission_control queue ~12k, p95 token latency ~650ms. Steering breaks their compliance requirements (data residency). It's just the demo window — need a short-lived fix.

ops-bot: FYI admission-control baseline: eviction threshold = 0.75 mem util, preemption policy = low-priority first. Docs: https://internal/redwood/admission-control :robot_face:

juniper: We can do a temporary priority label, but finance needs sign-off for surge cost. Also want a rollback plan in runbook.

raj: NovaHealth flagged this as revenue-critical. Sales ok to cover surge if cost reasonable. Please send estimate. :thumbsup:

micah: Rough calc: to avoid evictions we'd need ~2 extra GPU nodes for 2 hours => est cost ~$1.8k. CLI to apply label (ops):
```sh
rwctl tenant label set novahealth eviction_priority=high --expires 2h\```
Who can run this?

aline: I can run but prefer a canary. Suggest applying to one node group first and watch p95 for 10m. Proposed command: 
```sh
rwctl label apply --group west-g1 --tenant novahealth eviction_priority=high --expires 2h\```
If metrics look good, roll to the remaining groups.

juniper: I'll prepare the finance approval note. Tagging @finance-ledger for sign-off and to capture the extra charge.

finance-ledger: Approved up to $2,000 one-time surge credit for this account. Please confirm exact start/end times and actual spend after.

ops-bot: action: label apply queued. Executing canary on west-g1 at 1898765700. Notifying monitoring.

ops-bot: result: label applied to west-g1 for tenant novahealth by aline at 1898765700. Canary traffic redirected, autoscaler unchanged.

micah: Thanks — monitoring dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/cluster-west. Will keep an eye on p95 and queue length and report back in this thread.

aline: Canary looks stable after 12m: p95 down from 650ms -> 420ms, queue down ~60%. If no regressions in 10m we roll to other groups.

raj: Confirmed with NovaHealth — they can shift demo start by +10m if needed.

micah: Great. Once the full rollout is done, please post the exact cost and revoke the label at expiry.

ops-bot: scheduled revoke at expiry=1898766600.

juniper: Closing loop: finance will bill NovaHealth demo surge as one-off charge. I'll attach receipts and the runbook entry.

micah: Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone.
